Let's write a python script with proper User-Agent header to query Wikipedia API for Moon perigee and Kipchoge world record.
```python
script = '''
import urllib.request
import json
import re

headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'}

# Get Moon perigee
req_moon = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon', headers=headers)
data_moon = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req_moon).read())
text_moon = list(data_moon['query']['pages'].values())[0]['revisions'][0]['*']

perigee_lines = [line for line in text_moon.split('\\n') if 'perigee' in line.lower()]
print("Moon perigee lines:", perigee_lines)

# Get Kipchoge WR
req_kip = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Eliud_Kipchoge', headers=headers)
data_kip = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req_kip).read())
text_kip = list(data_kip['query']['pages'].values())[0]['revisions'][0]['*']

wr_lines = [line for line in text_kip.split('\\n') if 'marathon' in line.lower() or 'world record' in line.lower() or '2:0' in line]
print("Kipchoge WR lines:", wr_lines[:10])
'''
await write_file("./get_data.py", script)
out = await run_command("python ./get_data.py")
print(out)
```
